Question B-001-011-005.

Why the correct answer is right: A distressed amateur operator may use any means of radiocommunication; the emergency need is broader than ordinary band or mode limits.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "only use bands for which the operator is authorized": Normal band authorization is too restrictive for the distress situation described.
- sourceIndex 2: "use any means of radiocommunication, but only on internationally recognized emergency channels": The emergency permission is not confined to a named set of internationally recognized channels.
- sourceIndex 3: "only use Morse code communications on internationally recognized emergency channels": This wrongly adds both a Morse-only limit and an emergency-channel-only limit to the distress rule.
